title: AI agents design a compact CAR intracellular domain that enhances expression and function
summary: AI agents proposed and refined chimeric antigen receptor intracellular domains over three rounds of experimental feedback. A 45-amino-acid domain, krgr-z1-40, under a third the length of 4-1BB-CD3z, increased CAR surface expression and antigen-driven IFN-g release without detectable antigen-independent release, and enhanced B-cell depletion after delivery. This is a preprint and the extent of in vivo data is unknown.
ai_technology: AI agents proposing and refining CAR intracellular domain designs

evidence.tested: Experimental measurements of CAR expression, cytokine release and B-cell depletion.
evidence.unknown: In vivo efficacy and safety, and how much of the design was agent-driven rather than researcher-guided; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: AI agents proposed designs and revised them as measurements accumulated.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from the review input and author affiliations from Crossref metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
